description: This Python source file contains utility functions and classes used during TorchDynamo compilation, including hooks, tensor operations, autograd handling, and function wrappers.

classes.name: FakeBackwardCFunction

classes.name: _ApplyBackwardHook
classes.description: Custom autograd Function that applies a hook during backward pass.

classes.name: FakeCompiledAutogradEngine
